description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain franchise offering delivery and takeout only, with no dine-in seating at this downtown Vancouver location. The menu emphasizes quality ingredients including antibiotic-free chicken and pork, organic tomato sauce, and daily-fresh dough, with vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-smart options available. For a touring cyclist, this is a convenient fuel stop for hot pizza and sides in the West End neighbourhood.
